acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Create matter A with a confidential settlement amount and matter B with a different client. Store an attorney drafting preference separately. Close/reopen conversations: A's amount is available only in authorized A context, while the user's approved preference applies in B without importing A's facts. End-of-session promotion records source conversation and scope; extracted factual suggestions remain distinguishable from confirmed decisions. Correct A's source amount and revoke a user's access: later answers must not repeat the superseded amount as current or leak revoked content through memory, search, export or generated drafts. Conflicting memory must be surfaced for review, not silently resolved by recency alone. Preserve I/me/my and four-digit letter dates; unknown years remain flagged rather than guessed or omitted. Proposed controls and failure cases are requirements, not verified Clio behavior.

workflow.input: Approved synthetic matter facts, structured metrics, branding and audience selection
workflow.initial_state: Original synthetic fixture, no implementation environment
workflow.user_action: Generate, inspect and export a dashboard from an explicit source snapshot
workflow.output: Versioned HTML artifact with source manifest, visible calculations and an audience review record
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Source observations motivate proposed controls; source/commit/build and current vendor/legal entitlements remain unavailable.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Generate a dashboard from three synthetic events and a known expense table. Open the downloaded single HTML file offline: required content, labels and interactions remain usable and metrics reconcile with the source rows. Include hostile script-like source text and an inaccessible matter: escape untrusted content, exclude unauthorized data, and disclose any required external resource rather than calling it self-contained. Refresh a source fact: create a new artifact/version and show the old snapshot's date. Download, preview and local save cannot be reported as email transmission, client receipt or court filing. Require review of branding, party identity, intended audience and confidential content before any authorized sharing. This tests the requested program, not a generated mockup as implementation evidence.

workflow.output: Ranked findings with tier definitions, clause/page links, proposed language and rationale
workflow.exceptions_and_dependencies: Source observations motivate proposed controls; source/commit/build and current vendor/legal entitlements remain unavailable.

acceptance_test.scenario_and_expected_result: Plant a change-of-control severance clause, inconsistent non-compete terms, an exclusive supplier obligation and automatic renewal in versioned synthetic contracts. Analyze for the buyer, then for the seller: label perspective and supporting clauses, explain each risk tier and do not silently reuse the first perspective. Request changes only for employee B: exclude A/C proposed amendments while retaining their cited comparison context. Display original clause, proposed change and rationale; a redline-style checklist is not a verified Word tracked-change file or an executed amendment. Unknown or conflicting governing law requires explicit selection and current authority review. A legal citation or model assertion alone cannot certify enforceability. Test inaccessible files, an amended supplier contract and a missing clause without inventing obligations.

extensions.title: Permissions at analysis and export
